name: lihtness-gnomon-mcp
description: Deterministic batch tools so LLM agents stop next-token-guessing dates and math. Rich `now()` snapshot (18 fields), `calendar(ops)` batch dispatcher (diff/until/since/add/weekday/business_days, natural-language parsing), `calc(expressions)` Python eval with math+stats pre-loaded, and Pint-based unit conversion. One wiring for dates + math + units. Listed in the official MCP Server Registry. `uvx gnomon-mcp`.
